question: In 2024-25 IPEDS Institutional Characteristics, what percentage of undergraduates at Bentley University were formally registered with disability services? Explain whether an exact percentage is available.

answer.message: The requested values are not reported in the available source records. Missing values have not been treated as zero.

requested_time.description: IPEDS 2024-25 Institutional Characteristics; source text says the percentage refers to undergraduates enrolled in Fall 2023

assumptions: 164739 is treated as the UNITID.
DISABPCT is populated only when the institution's percentage is more than 3 percent. A blank/missing value is not zero and not an exact percentage.

The companion band indicator (DISAB: 3 percent or less / more than 3 percent / not reported / not applicable) is a coded field and is not selected as a measure; it determines whether an exact percentage exists.
The percentage covers all undergraduates enrolled in Fall 2023 registered with the disability services office, as reported in the 2024-25 collection.
